get.description:
Read one chunk of data from a session's output ring buffer. As the buffer only
retains the most recent bytes, the requested offset may have aged out; in that
case the read is moved forward and "actual_offset" reports where the data starts.
get.summary: Read one chunk of session output

parameters.description: Read index position within the session output stream
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Max number of bytes to read
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Strip ANSI escape sequences from the returned data
parameters.name: strip_ansi

get.description:
Continuously stream a session's output via server-sent events (SSE). Each event
carries a base64 encoded chunk of bytes read from the output ring buffer. The
stream runs until the client disconnects.

parameters.description: Read index position to start tailing from
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Milliseconds between buffer data availability checks (default 250)
parameters.name: poll_period_msec

parameters.description: Strip ANSI escape sequences from the streamed data
parameters.name: strip_ansi

put.description: Change the name of a session

parameters.description: New session name, can only contain alphanumeric characters and -
parameters.name: name

put.description:
Change the output buffer capacity of a session. Only permitted on IDLE sessions.
The change is performed through the session manager; by default the request is
non-blocking, set "block" to true to wait for the change to complete.

parameters.description: Whether to block until the change completes
parameters.name: block

put.description: Change the runner mode of a session. Only permitted on IDLE sessions.

post.description:
Bring up a session runner for an existing session and start it. By default
the request to the session manager is non-blocking; set "block" to true to
wait for the start to complete.

parameters.description: Whether to block until the start completes
parameters.name: block

post.description:
Bring a session back to IDLE and unload its runner. By default the request
to the session manager is non-blocking; set "block" to true to wait for the
stop to complete.

parameters.description: Whether to block until the stop completes
parameters.name: block

still in the buffer, and this reports that position.

content.description:
Content command content if needed

		For `TEXT` type, the content is the text to write to STDIN.

		For `CTRL` type, the content is the control character (e.g. C for CTRL+C, etc.).

		For `ENTRY` type, the content is ignored

		For `RAW` type, the content is the raw input byte slice (direct capture of
		keyboard presses, including ANSI characters, escape sequences, and control
		characters) in Base64 encoding.
